messages:
Lina: FYI we saw a gap in audit-forwarding during a private-deploy keystore failover this morning (~35m). ops-bot shows keystore switched to DR HSM at 01:42Z and log-forwarder restarted twice.
Sam: Which cluster?
Lina: ap-south-1 private-vpc-7. ops-bot entries: keystore.health.changed at 2026-05-09T01:42:12Z, forwarder.autoscale events 01:43-01:44Z.
Eli: Forwarder is configured ephemeral in private for perf; if pod crashes we lose buffered entries.
Maya: That implies durability gap. Any RBAC denies during the window?
Carol (infra): No explicit deny logged, but IRSA token rotation during keystore swap can cause transient 403s.
Sam: Short-term: patch daemonset to mount PVC and enable at-least-once. Patch example: kubectl patch daemonset log-forwarder -n infra -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"volumes":[{"name":"queue","persistentVolumeClaim":{"claimName":"log-forwarder-pvc"}}],"containers":[{"name":"forwarder","volumeMounts":[{"name":"queue","mountPath":"/var/queue"}]}]}}}}'
Maya: Also add a pre-failover webhook so keystore controller can request a drain/checkpoint.
Lina: Forensics steps: export HSM transition events, collect forwarder pod logs 01:30-02:15, run Splunk gap query: index=infra_logs source=keystore-audit cluster="private-vpc-7" earliest="01:30" latest="02:15" | sort 0 _time | table _time seqnum, and snapshot raw audit storage.
security-oncall: Filed INC-2026-1789. Triage: @Lina, @Carol. Track PRs and postmortem here.
Carol (infra): Opening infra#3189 to enable PVC + drain hook + netpol to pin egress to splunk. ETA review 4h.
Maya: Long-term: default durable queues for private, RBAC backstop during keystore handover, and canary failovers during low-traffic windows.
Sam: I'll run a sandbox failover and capture role-binding timeline.
Lina: Thanks — flag here if you find dropped PII-level events.
ops-bot: [automated] Incident INC-2026-1789 created at 2026-05-09T03:00:01Z.
